title: Assessing the Impact of Structural Learning Algorithms on Generative Model Rankings
summary: A research framework that trains multiple tabular generative models (CTGAN, TabDDPM, GMM) and studies how causal structure learning algorithms affect the ranking of these models under the CauTabBench evaluation methodology. It imports the standalone ctgan package (with a monkeypatch of CTGAN._train) to train one of its generative models and uses SDV's SingleTableMetadata to describe datasets during preprocessing.
evidence: ctgan_patch.py:1-4 monkeypatches CTGAN._train; src/data/preprocessor.py:6 imports SingleTableMetadata
needs: Unclear whether SingleTableMetadata is actually invoked (called) in preprocessor.py beyond import; no direct call site shown.
